title: A 2D and 3D cell culture protocol to study O-GlcNAc in sphingosine-1-phosphate mediated fibroblast contraction
protocol: Seed NIH3T3 cells at 1 × 10^5 cells per well in 12 wells of two 6-well cell culture dishes 8 hours prior to treatment with either small molecule inhibitors.
Treat a 6-well dish of NIH3T3 cells with either DMSO vehicle, 5SGlcNAc (200 μM), or Thiamet-G (10 μM).
Incubate the cells for 16 hours if treated with 5SGlcNAc/DMSO.
Incubate the cells for 20 hours if treated with Thiamet-G/DMSO.
Treat 1 well with DMSO as a control after appropriate incubation time.
Treat 5 wells of each plate with a S1P dose curve (0.05 μM, 0.1 μM, 0.5 μM, 1 μM, 5 μM) by pipetting it into the media.
Incubate the plate for 30 minutes.
Suspend at least 7 × 10^6 BJ-5ta cells in fresh media at 2 × 10^6 cells per mL.
Prepare the collagen solution on ice according to the ‘Collagen solution’ table above.
Add the collagen solution and 5× medium, mix well by gently pipetting up and down.
Add the neutralization solution and mix immediately.
Make a 4:1 mixture of collagen stock solution to cells in a pre-chilled 15 mL falcon tube and mix well.
To 12.936 mL of collagen solution, add 3.23 mL of BJ-5ta cells in media.
Pipette up and down carefully to avoid bubbles.
Do not vortex.
Plate 500 μL of the cell collagen solution into 30 wells in two 24-well dishes.
Incubate the cell-collagen matrix at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 1 h to allow collagen polymerization to occur.
Add 1 mL of prewarmed media very gently to each well.
Press the pipet tip against the wall of the well and depress the plunger slowly.
Incubate the matrix at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 30 h.
Supplement the wells with DMSO vehicle or with either 5SGlcNAc (200 μM) or Thiamet-G (10 μM).
Treat 15 wells with DMSO vehicle and 15 wells with 5SGlcNAc/Thiamet-G.
Incubate for an additional 16 h.
After incubation, carefully aspirate the liquid media out of the well.
Replace the media with serum-free media containing S1P or no S1P as a control.
Treat 6 wells with each concentration of S1P: 3 wells pre-treated with DMSO and 3 wells pre-treated with 5SGlcNAc.
Treat one row of 6 wells with DMSO as a control.
Initiate contraction by gently releasing the sides and bottom of the matrix from the plate using a 10 μL pipet tip.
Image the wells using a ChemiDoc XRS+ molecular imager (Bio-Rad) immediately after release (t = 0).
Alternatively, take images with any type of imager or measure the matrix with a ruler.
Incubate the matrix at 37°C for 30 min and then image the wells again (t = 30).
Quantify the change in diameter of each matrix using ImageJ.
